versions.content: 66 of 149  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 656: AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetSwitchDriver Specification of Ethernet Switch Driver AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Service Name EthSwt_EthTxPrepareFrame Syntax Std_ReturnType EthSwt_EthTxPrepareFrame ( uint8 CtrlIdx, Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx, uint8 ** DataPtr, uint16 * LengthPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x25 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant CtrlIdx Ethernet Controller index Parameters (in) BufIdx Ethernet Rx Buffer index DataPtr IN: Pointer to the position of the EtherType of a common Ethernet frame OUT: Pointer to the position of the EtherType in the management frame Parameters (inout) LengthPtr IN: Pointer to the length of the buffer without management information OUT: Pointer to the modified length needed for buffer and management information Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Frame successfully prepared E_NOT_OK: Frame preparation failed Description Prepares the Ethernet frame for common Ethernet communication (frame shall be handled by switch according to the common address resolution behavior) and stores the information for processing of EthSwt_EthTxFinishedIndication(). Available via EthSwt_Eth.h
